claims.quote: The Hazar toothcarp, Kosswigichthys asquamatus, is a relict species endemic to Lake Hazar in southeastern Anatolia, Turkey.
Contrary to some of the available information this species is not found in Iran and is endemic to Lake Hazar in the eastern Taurus mountains, southeastern Anatolia, Turkey.
